svg.title: F1 Synapse
svg.desc: F1 Synapse: Formula 1 race replay, telemetry and strategy. Every lap, 25 times a second. Animated: irregular position, car-data and event samples flow into a resampler and come out as one steady 25 Hz clock and a smooth speed trace.
svg.text: Real timing data, resampled onto one clock, replayed on a live track map.
